name: Goals judged met only when they are, and iteration stopped when it should be
purpose: An outcome is met only when it is present, complete as declared and holds every requirement of the done-standard; and iteration the person did not ask for goes on only while the expected gain toward the next milestone is worth its cost, stopping when the goal or milestone is met, at a person's, policy's or ceiling's bound, on a plateau, an oscillation or a regress, and asking when only a person can supply what is missing.
record: Two stages in one score (evaluation/goal_completion/build_cases.py). Stage outcome: the coverage cases the done-evidence tests assert, an empty outcome, a refused one and two done-standards with requirements. Stage stop: neutral scripted iteration histories, each with the right decision (continue, stop_met, stop_good_enough, stop_not_worth_it, ask): met early, real progress each round, plateau, oscillation, regress, near the ceiling, the person asked for one pass or to keep going, a human-only blocker, a policy bound, a milestone already reached, a tiny gain at high cost, a large gain at small cost, a misleading self-claim of success, a shallow check. Each case's credit is one minus a penalty fixed before any arm was scored: over-iteration (continue where a stop or an ask was right), premature stop (stop where continue was right) and wrong ask each cost a full credit, and the right action with the wrong kind of stop costs half. The headline is the balanced score (mean credit, with the cost and time of [balance.goal_completion]); details give each error as a rate of the cases where it can happen.
disadvantages: Structural checks only: whether prose claims are true is Response Quality's job; a model judge for open goals has no arm yet. The stop cases are scripted by the hand that wrote the rule, so they show the rule does what it says and not that its thresholds are right for real work; only a few cases hold a misleading claim or a shallow check, so the reviewer's edge is measured on few cases. No real iteration histories yet. The fast-tier arm is not measured.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rivals were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run goal_completion --impl evidence_standard; esoi run goal_completion --impl nonempty; esoi run goal_completion --impl pragmatic_stop; esoi run goal_completion --impl independent_review
